summary: Butterfield filed a Form 6-K furnishing a press release announcing voting results from its 2026 Annual General Meeting held virtually on September 18, 2026. Proposals 1 through 4 were approved by the requisite shareholder vote, while Proposal 5, seeking authority to adjourn or postpone the meeting if votes were insufficient for Proposal 4, was unnecessary and not presented. No special-situation transaction, stake, price, premium or strategic action is disclosed. The filing is a routine foreign-private-issuer meeting-results notice (US equivalent: an 8-K furnishing AGM outcomes), with no deal terms and no risk-arb angle.
